candidate_documents_publish_requires_rig.name: candidate_documents_publish_requires_rights_check
candidate_documents_publish_requires_rig.value:
"candidate_documents"."publication_state" != 'published' OR (
        "candidate_documents"."review_state" = 'approved'
        AND "candidate_documents"."content_snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_documents"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_documents"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_documents"."retention_outcome" = 'stored-publishable'
        AND "candidate_documents"."rights_state" IN ('candidate-permission', 'publisher-permission', 'redistributable')
      )

candidate_media_publish_rights_check.name: candidate_media_publish_rights_check
candidate_media_publish_rights_check.value:
"candidate_media_assets"."publication_state" != 'published' OR (
        "candidate_media_assets"."review_state" = 'approved'
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."content_snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."retention_outcome" = 'stored-publishable'
        AND "candidate_media_assets"."rights_state" IN ('candidate-permission', 'redistributable')
      )

evidence_segment_requires_transcript_che.name: evidence_segment_requires_transcript_check
evidence_segment_requires_transcript_che.value: "evidence"."transcript_segment_id" IS NULL OR "evidence"."transcript_id" IS NOT NULL

ingestion_host_rate_limits_lease_pair_ch.name: ingestion_host_rate_limits_lease_pair_check
ingestion_host_rate_limits_lease_pair_ch.value: ("ingestion_host_rate_limits"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "ingestion_host_rate_limits"."lease_expires_at_ms" IS NULL) OR ("ingestion_host_rate_limits"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "ingestion_host_rate_limits"."lease_expires_at_ms" IS NOT NULL)

transcript_jobs_single_input_check.name: transcript_jobs_single_input_check
transcript_jobs_single_input_check.value: ("transcript_jobs"."candidate_document_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_jobs"."candidate_link_id" IS NULL) OR ("transcript_jobs"."candidate_document_id" IS NULL AND "transcript_jobs"."candidate_link_id" IS NOT NULL)

transcript_jobs_lease_pair_check.name: transcript_jobs_lease_pair_check
transcript_jobs_lease_pair_check.value: ("transcript_jobs"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "transcript_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("transcript_jobs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

transcript_segments_time_check.name: transcript_segments_time_check
transcript_segments_time_check.value: ("transcript_segments"."start_milliseconds" IS NULL AND "transcript_segments"."end_milliseconds" IS NULL) OR ("transcript_segments"."start_milliseconds" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_segments"."end_milliseconds" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_segments"."start_milliseconds" >= 0 AND "transcript_segments"."end_milliseconds" >= "transcript_segments"."start_milliseconds")

transcript_segments_offset_check.name: transcript_segments_offset_check
transcript_segments_offset_check.value: ("transcript_segments"."start_offset" IS NULL AND "transcript_segments"."end_offset" IS NULL) OR ("transcript_segments"."start_offset" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_segments"."end_offset" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_segments"."start_offset" >= 0 AND "transcript_segments"."end_offset" >= "transcript_segments"."start_offset")
